verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair privacy question for a client-side rendering engine distributed via npm, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, analytics, or any opt-out control. The docs and probes cover rendering, physics, tooling, npm packaging and llms.txt only, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
